userIdByEmail: SELECT id FROM users WHERE email=?
setAccessLevel: UPDATE users SET access_level=? WHERE id=?
visibleCourses: SELECT c.*,u.name AS trainer FROM courses c JOIN users u ON u.id=c.owner WHERE c.published=1 OR c.owner=? ORDER BY c.id DESC
courseProgress: SELECT completed,notes FROM progress WHERE user_id=? AND course_id=?
courseAttempts: SELECT id,score,passed,created,revision FROM attempts WHERE user_id=? AND course_id=? ORDER BY id DESC
ownedCourse: SELECT * FROM courses WHERE id=? AND owner=?
publishedCourse: SELECT * FROM courses WHERE id=? AND published=1
progressRecord: SELECT * FROM progress WHERE user_id=? AND course_id=?
saveProgress: INSERT INTO progress(user_id,course_id,completed,notes) VALUES(?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(user_id,course_id) DO UPDATE SET completed=excluded.completed,notes=excluded.notes
learners: SELECT id,name,email FROM users WHERE role='learner' ORDER BY name
ownedCourseSummaries: SELECT id,title,published,revision,category FROM courses WHERE owner=? ORDER BY id DESC
ownedLearnerAttempts: SELECT a.* FROM attempts a JOIN courses c ON c.id=a.course_id JOIN users u ON u.id=a.user_id WHERE c.owner=? AND u.role='learner' ORDER BY a.id DESC
ownedProgress: SELECT p.user_id,p.course_id,p.completed FROM progress p JOIN courses c ON c.id=p.course_id WHERE c.owner=?
users: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY name
teamResults: SELECT a.id,a.score,a.passed,a.created,c.title,u.name,u.email FROM attempts a JOIN courses c ON c.id=a.course_id JOIN users u ON u.id=a.user_id WHERE c.owner=? ORDER BY a.id DESC
sessionUser: SELECT u.* FROM users u JOIN sessions s ON s.user_id=u.id WHERE s.token=? AND s.expires>?
updateUserAccess: UPDATE users SET role=?,access_level=?,permissions=? WHERE id=?
